text: Pane: A light theme with a dark accent still risks blending into white backgrounds in bright rooms, and the "dark accent" alone won’t fix glare—users will squint at charts outdoors. Test a *dynamic* theme that shifts contrast based on ambient light, and measure task completion time in both settings; if it’s slower than pure dark mode in dim light, the risk outweighs the gain.

text: Pane: A light theme with dark accents still risks blending into white backgrounds in bright offices—users will squint to read text. name: Lumen
text: DECISION: Default to a **dynamic theme** that auto-switches between light and dark based on ambient light, with a manual brightness slider override. The result must deliver a working prototype with a live ambient light sensor and toggleable brightness slider, owned by the visualization team.
